effect.name: Division With Arcsinus (Background)
effect.description: Base and blend colors are divided after which the colors are reduced by the arcsinus function.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Division With Arcsinus (Background) Shader | 2026.08.18 */
parameter.description: Base and blend colors are divided after which the colors are reduced by the arcsinus function.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable manages which color will be the divider. When this value is set to 0 then blend will divide base and when set to 1 then base will divide blend.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Background Multiplication
parameter.description: This variable defines the background multiplication factor. In previous versions of FSP shaders, it was _Mixing, but this has now been fixed.

parameter.name: Render Switch
parameter.description: This variable specifies which mode of the arcsinus function is to be used. A setting value of 0 uses the arcosinus function used in the current graphics API. A value set to 1 uses the arcsinus function *simulated* from Direct3D9 (not an exact copy) and a value set to 2 uses the arcsinus function *simulated* from Direct3D11 and OpenGL (not an exact copy).
